channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Miami-Dade County raises limit on investments in Israel Bonds
item.description: Miami-Dade raises its Israel Bonds investment cap from 3% to 5%, potentially allowing up to $450 million, as opponents protest and tempers flare.

item.title: Red Cross visits to terrorists to resume
item.description: Red Cross visits to Israeli prisons are expected to resume for the first time since October 7. National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir criticized the High Court directive.

item.title: Ben Gvir against resuming visits to security prisoners
item.description: National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir attacked the High Court's directive to allow visits to security prisoners for the first time since October 7. He said the decision "constitutes a direct attack on the security deterrence of the State of Israel."

item.title: Trump threatens to ban Canadian aircraft manufacturer from selling its products in the US
item.description: President Trump is intensifying his tone against Canada, as part of the trade war: The president has threatened to ban Canadian aircraft manufacturer Bombardier from selling its planes in the US - unless it transfers some of the production to his country.

item.title: Report: Red Cross visits to security prisoners will resume
item.description: For the first time since October 7, the defense establishment is preparing to resume Red Cross visits to security prisoners in Israeli prisons. According to Channel 12 News, the visits are expected to resume as early as this Wednesday.

item.title: Haredi political first: Woman joins party’s Knesset slate
item.description: Dr. Nechumi Yaffe joins HaTzibur HaCharedi, becoming the first woman included on the Knesset slate of a haredi party running in Israeli elections.

item.title: Rabbi Tau: Noam Party to run all the way
item.description: Rabbi Tzvi Tau instructs Avi Maoz and Noam activists to press ahead with their independent Knesset run, declaring the party will remain in the race through election day.

item.title: Winter and Haddad celebrate filing of Amcha Yisrael party list with baklava
item.description:
Winter and Haddad celebrate filing of Amcha Yisrael party list with baklava
Amcha Yisrael Party chairman Ofer Winter and the slate’s number two candidate, Yoseph Haddad, were filmed celebrating with baklava after submitting their Knesset slate.

item.title: Police raid uncovers massive stash of ‘pirate’ gas cylinders
item.description: Police seize over half a ton of gas cylinders allegedly brought illegally from Judea and Samaria and dangerously stored and sold without required safety checks.

item.title: Last second: IDF redirects strike on Hamas terrorist to avoid hittng civilians
item.description:
0:00 / 1x IDF redirects strike to avoid harming civiliansIDF Spokesperson
Yesterday (Sunday), the IDF intended to carry out a strike targeting a Hamas military wing terrorist in the Gaza Strip.
During the strike, a gathering of civilians was identified near the terrorist. Since the munition could not be canceled after it had been released, it was redirected in real time to prevent harm to civilians.

item.title: US lawmakers pledge: “Sanctions against countries that boycott Judea and Samaria"
item.description: A delegation of 20 American lawmakers toured Samaria and announced that they would work to advance countermeasures against entities that boycott residents because of where they live.

item.title: Smotrich attacks - Winter fires back
item.description: After Winter submitted an independent slate, Smotrich attacked his decision; Amcha Yisrael chairman responds: “The public is asking for new people."

item.title: Running alone: Ofer Winter submits Amcha Yisrael slate
item.description: Ofer Winter files Amcha Yisrael slate and rules out a merger with Smotrich, who warns the independent run risks right-wing rule; Winter rejects ‘fearmongering.’

item.title: IDF eliminates Nukhba company commander
item.description:
Yesterday (Sunday), the IDF struck in the Gaza City area and eliminated the terrorist Yusuf Aqila, a Nukhba company commander in Hamas’ military wing.
In recent weeks, the terrorist advanced attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians and worked to restore the terrorist organization's capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorist was eliminated to remove the threat he posed.

item.title: Hatzibur HaCharedi refuses Amcha Yisrael merger offer
item.description:
Hatzibur HaCharedi announced today that it has informed the chairman of the Amcha Yisrael party that it will not accept the merger proposal presented to it. Party officials said the decision was based on current polling, which, in their assessment, does not provide sufficient confidence that the proposed arrangement would cross the electoral threshold, nor would it secure adequate representation for the haredi public and answer the needs of its voters.
“Hatzibur HaCharedi will not enter into an arrangement that fails to provide our voters with a credible path to parliamentary representation," party officials said.
The party added that it remains committed to securing representation in the next Knesset for the Charedi public who are not represented, and the party leadership will continue to evaluate all available political options to secure that representation.

item.title: Stabbing victim recounts: “I fought the terrorist - Then I saw I was covered in blood"
item.description: Netanel Jacobs recounts from his hospital bed at Beilinson the struggle with the terrorist who stabbed him.

item.title: GDP grows, investment surges: Israeli economy shows resilience ahead of Rosh Hashanah
item.description: Finance Ministry data released ahead of Rosh Hashanah 5787 show growth in Israel’s economy despite years of war and uncertainty, with foreign investment surging 78%, inflation falling and the shekel strengthening.

item.title: 2 IDF soldiers injured in close-quarters combat with Hezbollah terrorist
item.description:
Earlier today (Monday), during IDF patrols in the Beaufort area in southern Lebanon, a Hezbollah terrorist inside a building opened fire at the soldiers.
The soldiers returned fire and eliminated the terrorist.
During the close-quarters encounter, two IDF soldiers were lightly injured and were evacuated to receive medical treatment. Their families have been notified.
Additionally, the IDF struck weapons storage facilities, command centers, and additional terrorist infrastructure belonging to the Hezbollah terrorist organization in the area.

item.title: Thailand orders deportation of park director who banned Israelis from entering
item.description: Thai authorities have ordered the deportation of Kevin Dimino, director of a wildlife park on Koh Samui, after he placed a Palestinian flag and signs prohibiting the entry of Israelis.

item.title: Watch: Lebanese reporter injured during live broadcast
item.description: Ali Shabib, a reporter for the Hezbollah-affiliated Al-Manar network, was injured in an IDF strike in Nabatieh. Footage shows the moment he was hit during the live broadcast.

item.title: Exclusive: Ben-Gvir adds Hebron Spokesman Yishai Fleisher to election slate
item.description: Ben-Gvir places pro-Israel advocate and Hebron spokesman Yishai Fleisher at No. 12 on Otzma Yehudit’s Knesset slate ahead of the upcoming elections.

item.title: Smotrich hunts for new faces ahead of Knesset slate deadline
item.description: Religious Zionist Party leader Bezalel Smotrich says he is seeking women, Sephardim, candidates from the periphery and reservists to join slate - but won’t sideline MKs without electoral gain.

item.title: Haredi shakeup spreads: Belz set to replace Yisrael Eichler
item.description: After more than two decades as Belz’s Knesset representative, MK Yisrael Eichler is expected to make way for Elikim Stark at the Rebbe’s instruction.

item.title: Yamam commandos airlifted into surprise Eilat terror drill
item.description: Israel’s elite counterterrorism unit practices hostage rescues and neutralizing terrorists in an extreme multi-front attack scenario.

item.title: Orthodox rabbis gather in Brooklyn to mark RAA’s 84th anniversary
item.description: Rabbinical Alliance of America honors community leaders, warns of rising antisemitism and adopts resolutions backing Israel and opposing a Palestinian state.

item.title: Parents shut down preschool after three break-ins in days
item.description: Rosh Ha'ayin parents refuse to send children back to preschool until security is improved following consecutive intrusions into the compound.

item.title: Mike Huckabee: 'It’s a daily occurrence that Israelis have to live with'
item.description: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee condemns Samaria terror attack, says Israelis face daily attacks that receive less international attention.

item.title: Huckabee responds to stabbing attack, slamming world hypocrisy
item.description: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee responded: "This won’t get the international attention that attacks on Palestinians receive but it’s a daily occurrence that Israelis have to live with. for the 'Peace of Jerusalem.'"
